newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber SIR20 unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber SIR20 unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Thursday, with few fresh enquiries, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices remained at 54.50-55.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.25-54.50 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 53.75-54.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"The market is very very quiet. I expect the slow demand to continue in the coming days," one Medan dealer said.
Another dealer, however, said they expected demand to rise in the near term following news reports on falls in Japan rubber stock figures
Dealers said January high amoniac grade latex was on offer at 2,150 rupiah/kg in Bandung and Tangerang against 2,175 rupiah previously on the back of slow demand.
